test_first_evidence.failure_summary: New Tier A family failed before source repair because ModifierRuntimePacket and ModifierReplayReceipt retained caller-owned nested ResolvedCoefficientValue instances whose modifier_inputs could be mutated after packet or receipt construction. The bounded repair detaches coefficient lineage lists and nested coefficient models on contract construction.

records.active_behaviour_summary: Modifier runtime packets and replay receipts remain Pydantic extra-forbid contract carriers. They reject top-level execution/capital authority fields and now detach active modifier IDs, policy IDs, resolved surfaces, closed authority classes, and nested resolved-coefficient lineage state from caller-owned inputs.
